thread:
olivia: Heads-up — pushing release/2026.03 to canary in the 01:00 change window. Main concerns: embeddings latency and a potential cold-start spike.

matt: ETA on the deploy?

olivia: Start at 01:10 UTC, will ramp to 3% -> hold -> 25% -> hold -> 100%. Two holdpoints for smoke checks.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: release/2026.03. Canary policy: [3%,25%,100%]. Holdpoints at 25% for 10m and pre-100% for 15m. Pin: model-serving v3.0-rc -> pinned to podpool-12.

sasha: Adding checklist: 1) canary smoke ok (latency & error budget) 2) embeddings QPS baseline 3) rollout pin ready 4) rollback triggers verified.

ana: @sasha small correction — embedding QPS baseline should reference last 24h median, not 7d.

sasha: good catch, updated.

chris: Quick note on rollback triggers: scoped to 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 3m OR p99 latency > 2.5x baseline for 2m. Also network egress errors count as a partial-failure signal.

olivia: can we make the canary holdpoint manual at 25%? want a human go/no-go after smoke scripts.

matt: agree — manual hold at 25%. automation continues for 3% step only.

deploy-bot: Canary advanced to 3% at 01:12 UTC — smoke tests running.

olivia: smoke tests running locally and on canary. emb-smoke: PASS, gen-smoke: PASS, kv-cache warmup looks normal.

pagerbot: Incident check: no active incidents in region-us-west.

sasha: running the latency diff script: p50/p95/p99 compared to baseline: p50 +5%, p95 +8%, p99 +12% (within alert thresholds).

olivia: leaving note: gating checklist item — performance within expected. ready to proceed to 25% once matt gives thumbs.

matt: thumbs. :thumbsup: Proceed to manual hold at 25%. Please monitor token cost for embeddings during ramp.

deploy-bot: Manual holdpoint reached at 25% at 01:28 UTC. Timer paused. Awaiting human confirmation to continue.

ana: running extended smoke (10m): embedding tail latency stable, error rate 0.03%.

chris: double-checking rollback playbook: if we trigger rollback, use /deploy rollback release/2026.02 and unpin model-serving, then scale back to previous podpool and revert routing.

olivia: documenting release notes snippet: "2026.03: model-serving v3.0-rc, improved KV cache warmup, p99 latency improvements for short prompts, embeddings quantization opt-in."

matt: should we include an exemption for overnight freeze for emergency hotfixes? asking security.

sasha: security okay with emergency hotfix channel but requires a postmortem within 24h. add to release notes.

olivia: manual go issued at 01:33 UTC — continuing to 100% ramp after a 15m observational hold.

deploy-bot: Canary advanced to 50% at 01:40 UTC. Observational hold scheduled for 15m prior to 100%.

chris: monitoring dashboards — no spike in 5xx, some slight tail variance in emb p99 but still below trigger.

olivia: final note for runbook: holdpoint owners: olivia (canary smoke), chris (rollback), matt (release lead). Recovery runbook pinned in #eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed to 100% at 01:55 UTC. Release/2026.03 deployed.

olivia: post-deploy checklist: run smoke integrations, run synthetic user flows, confirm no degradations in first 30m.

ana: post-deploy smoke: all green at 10m.

matt: closing the change window. leaving reminder to update the release notes doc and schedule a quick sync tomorrow if any anomalies appear.

olivia: thanks all. archived rollout notes under /releases/2026.03. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
